data.title: Speeding fine notice, €98.50
data.summary: The City of Musterau fines office (Bußgeldstelle) issued a fine notice for speeding 23 km/h over the limit on 30 April 2026. The total is €98.50, with 1 point in the driving aptitude register.
data.explanation: You are accused of driving 93 km/h in a 70 km/h zone outside built-up areas. The total is €98.50 (fine €70, fee €25, expenses €3.50) and 1 point is recorded. You may file an objection (Einspruch), in writing or on record at the fines office. The app shows the deadline, counted from the delivery date stamped on the envelope. If you do not object in time, the notice becomes final and can be enforced. Payment is due within two weeks of the notice becoming final (Rechtskraft). You may want advice from a lawyer if you consider objecting.
